overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. The notice was actually posted at 8:30 A.M. on December 2, 2015, so it was at least 48 hours before the meeting; the Town Clerk's 8:30 P.M. date stamp was a clerical error. The AG also reminded the Board that it must meet to review a complaint and formulate a response, or delegate that authority.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board posted notice of its December 4, 2015 meeting on December 2 at 8:30 P.M., fewer than 48 hours before the meeting.
